answer: Bindings are kept in walnut, verified in crystal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the shale check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, and therefore it has to store and read state per alias. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 23 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
